## validateSlippageTolerance() function

Validates that a slippage tolerance is within an acceptable range.

Throws [NegativeInputError](./morpho-sdk.negativeinputerror.md) if negative. Throws [ExcessiveSlippageToleranceError](./morpho-sdk.excessiveslippagetoleranceerror.md) if greater than [MAX\_SLIPPAGE\_TOLERANCE](./morpho-sdk.max_slippage_tolerance.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateSlippageTolerance: (slippageTolerance: bigint) => void
```

**Returns:**

void

Nothing when the slippage tolerance is valid.

## Exceptions

`NegativeInputError` when `slippageTolerance < 0n`<!-- -->.

`ExcessiveSlippageToleranceError` when the tolerance exceeds the SDK maximum.

## Example


```ts
import { validateSlippageTolerance } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const result: void = validateSlippageTolerance(5_000000000000000n);
```
